source: BK4 printed pp.78-79 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.84-85; builds on IV-EXP6 (BK4 printed p.77 = PDF p.83); ERRATA ER-24 (conditional, not applied)
note: Delta program: wires = the IV-EXP6 printed 48-wire list (p.77) with the p.79 REMOVE list (3A/M10, 3L/4X, 3H/4Z, 4N/5X, 4K/5Z, 6H/6X, 6L/6Z) taken out and the ADD list (6F/M10, 3L/4Z, 3H/4X, 4N/5Z, 4K/5X, 6C/6F, 6H/6Z, 6L/6X) put in, 49 wires; no erratum changes a wire in either list, so as_printed = wires. ER-24 (errata p.3, 'Note on Experiment 7') applies only 'if you used the alternate circuit for the counter'; this fixture is the book circuit and does not apply it (its remove list names 2C/2G and 3C/3G, which neither IV-EXP6 nor this program wires). Script: the page prints one worked example (5 - 2 = 3) and one hypothetical (subtractor 7 against the same subtrahend: relay 6 does not pull in). Light 3 and relay 6 for the 5 - 2 case are not stated on the page and are not asserted. The 500 ms advances before each expect let lamps finish thermal transients; the page states no timing. The 111 hypothetical is entered fresh: pushbutton 5 is released, then pushbuttons 4, 5 and 6 are pushed.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.79 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.85 (procedure steps 1-3)
script.quote: 1. Enter the subtrahend (101) by moving slide switches 4 and 6 to the LEFT, leaving slide switch 5 RIGHT. 2. Enter the subtractor (010) by pushing pushbutton 5 DOWN and leaving pushbuttons 4 and 6 UP. ... 3. The answer appears in the binary output lights: light 4 is OFF, and lights 5 and 6 are ON. This is read as 011, which is binary 3 : 5 - 2 = 3.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.79 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.85
script.quote: Had we attempted to enter binary 7 (111) in the pushbuttons, relay 6—the carry in relay for the low order stage— would not have pulled in and the answer displayed in the output lights would be incorrect.
